messages:
maria_oncall: quick sync re: Lamar on-prem isolation postmortem. root cause appears to be VPC peering flap combined with MTU issues on their vendor appliance. need owners for RCA, detection, customer checklist, and comms.
raj_prod: I can take the networking RCA and liaise with Lamar infra. aim: 3 business days. creating INF-4821 and will attach logs.
olivia_se: I'll draft the on-prem constraints + migration checklist. will include MTU recommendations and vendor appliance notes. ETA 5 days.
kevin_sre: I'll implement a Prometheus alert for peer flaps and propose an automated probe to validate peer re-establish. alert in 48h, probe PR in next sprint. rule idea:
```
expr: peer_bgp_state == 0 and increase(peer_bgp_flaps_total[5m]) > 0
```
Alert: peer-bgp-flap-detected -> runbook soft-restart BGP, escalate if >3 restarts in 10m.
tara_support: I'll own customer comms and schedule a remediation window with Lamar. will send a short status note today.
maria_oncall: thanks. priority list: RCA (raj), detection (kevin), checklist (olivia), comms (tara). add owners to INF-4821 and set due dates.
raj_prod: blocking: need Lamar's BGP debug logs and read-only config access. @maria_oncall can you confirm?
maria_oncall: confirmed, Lamar shared read-only via secure-share and I added link in INF-4821.
kevin_sre: started alert branch, tagging eng-sre for review. deploy-bot queued staging tests.
deploy-bot: deploy:prometheus-alerts v1.4 queued by kevin_sre — running tests in staging. :robot_face:
olivia_se: checklist draft includes: pre-deploy MTU validation, peer session stability test, vendor appliance fragmentation guidance.
tara_support: scheduled customer sync Fri 10:00 PT and copied remediation owners. will propose temporary traffic shaping until MTU fix.
maria_oncall: note recurring pattern: saw similar peering+MTU isolation on two other private customers in last 6 months. raj, can you add "recurring peering/MTU" section to RCA and recommend pre-deploy checks for Dedicated/Private?
raj_prod: will add that section and propose gating check in onboarding.
maria_oncall: next check-in Tue EOD unless urgent. please update INF-4821 with progress. :thumbsup:
